group.selected.description: Timeline: end of an item's tooltip while it is in a selection of several, after " · "; {n} is how many are selected. Ctrl is a keycap.

group.selectSeveral.description: Timeline: end of an item's tooltip, after " · ", while nothing is selected. Ctrl is a keycap.

hint.description: Timeline: the hint above the tracks. Ctrl, Shift and Alt are keycaps.

selected.description: Timeline: how many items are selected together (two or more), above the tracks; {n} is the number.

clearSelection.description: Timeline: button that clears a selection of several items; its shortcut (Esc) follows in brackets.

zoomGroup.description: Timeline: accessible name of the timeline's zoom buttons.

zoomOut.description: Timeline: button that shows more of the recording; its shortcut may follow in brackets.

zoomIn.description: Timeline: accessible name of the button that shows the recording larger.

zoomInKeys.description: Timeline: tooltip of the zoom-in button; {keys} is its shortcut. Ctrl+wheel is the mouse gesture that also zooms; Ctrl is a keycap.

zoomInWheel.description: Timeline: tooltip of the zoom-in button when it has no shortcut. Ctrl is a keycap.

fit.description: Timeline: button that zooms the timeline out to show the whole recording.

track.clip.description: Timeline: tooltip of the clip track's label.

track.shapes.description: Timeline: tooltip of the shapes track's label.

clipTrack.hint.description: Timeline: tooltip of the clip track; the waveform's hint may follow after " · ". Shift is a keycap.

trimStart.description: Timeline: tooltip of the handle at the start of the kept recording.

trimEnd.description: Timeline: tooltip of the handle at the end of the kept recording.

cutRange.description: Timeline: tooltip of the Cut button on a selected range; its shortcut follows in brackets.

zoomTrack.add.description: Timeline: tooltip of the zoom track, and its hint while it is empty (", or press Z" may follow).

scrollBand.description: Timeline: tooltip of a band on the zoom track where the recording scrolls; {start} and {end} are timecodes.

zoomLink.description: Timeline: tooltip of the link between two zooms.

zoom.region.description: Timeline: a zoom that frames a drawn area, shown after its level on the block ("1.5× · region").

zoom.fixed.description: Timeline: a zoom that stays on one place, shown after its level on the block ("1.5× · fixed").

zoom.auto.description: Timeline: a zoom made automatically, shown on its block ("1.5× · auto").

range.description: Timeline: a span of time in a tooltip; {start} and {end} are timecodes.

zoom.pullBack.description: Timeline: in a zoom's tooltip: a zoom below 1× shows more than the frame; {level} is its factor ("0.75×").

zoom.automatic.description: Timeline: in a zoom's tooltip: made by auto zoom.

zoom.edited.description: Timeline: in a zoom's tooltip: added or changed by hand.

zoom.pansToNext.description: Timeline: in a zoom's tooltip: the camera moves straight into the next zoom.

textTrack.add.description: Timeline: tooltip of the text track, and its hint while it is empty (", or press T" may follow).

shapeTrack.add.description: Timeline: tooltip of the shapes track.

shapeTrack.empty.description: Timeline: hint on the empty shapes track.

gap.cut.description: Timeline: tooltip of a cut part of the recording; {start} and {end} are timecodes, {length} its length in seconds (s stays Latin).

gap.trimmed.description: Timeline: tooltip of a trimmed start or end of the recording; {start} and {end} are timecodes, {length} its length in seconds (s stays Latin).

gap.restore.description: Timeline: button on a cut part that puts it back.

transport.pause.description: Transport under the preview: the play button while the video plays; its shortcut follows in brackets.

transport.timecode.description: Transport under the preview: tooltip of the timecode.

transport.splitTitle.description: Transport under the preview: tooltip of Split; its shortcut follows in brackets.

transport.split.description: Transport under the preview: button that splits the clip at the playhead.

transport.addZoomTitle.description: Transport under the preview: tooltip of the Zoom button; its shortcut follows in brackets.

transport.addTextTitle.description: Transport under the preview: tooltip of the Text button; its shortcut follows in brackets.

safeZones.allThree.description: Transport under the preview: the choice of the safe-zone menu that shades every app's zones (TikTok, Reels and Shorts).

safeZones.title.description: Transport under the preview: tooltip of Safe zones (tall frames only); its shortcut follows in brackets.

safeZones.button.description: Transport under the preview: button that shades the parts of a tall frame the apps cover.

safeZones.of.description: Transport under the preview: accessible name of the menu that picks whose safe zones are shaded ("Safe zones of TikTok").

safeZones.legend.description: Transport under the preview: note under the preview while safe zones are shown.

snapping.on.description: Timeline: tooltip of the magnet button while snapping is on; its shortcut follows in brackets. Alt is a keycap.

snapping.off.description: Timeline: tooltip of the magnet button while snapping is off; its shortcut follows in brackets.

snapping.label.description: Timeline: accessible name of the magnet button that turns snapping on and off.

previewSpeed.description: Transport: accessible name of the menu of preview speeds.

snap.image.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. An image block.

snap.titleCard.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A title card block.

snap.popUp.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A pop-up graphic block.

snap.caption.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A caption block.

snap.cameraLayout.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A camera layout block.

snap.cut.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The edge of a cut part of the recording (a noun).

snap.split.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A split between two clips (a noun).

snap.trim.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The trimmed start or end of the recording (a noun).

snap.start.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The start of the recording.

snap.end.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The end of the recording.

snap.freeze.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A freeze frame.

snap.chapter.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A chapter without a title.

snap.chapterTitled.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A chapter; {title} is its title.

snap.click.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. A recorded click.

snap.playhead.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The playhead.

snap.edgeStart.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The start of a block; {name} is the block's kind ("Zoom", "Camera layout").

snap.edgeEnd.description: Snap guide on the timeline: the name of what a dragged edge snapped to, shown with its time. The end of a block; {name} is the block's kind ("Zoom", "Camera layout").
